generalities.text: Main THE ENCYCLOPEDIA OF PURE MATERIA MEDICA By TIMOTHY F. ALLEN, A.M., M.D. Presented by Médi-T <<<<< CINNABARIS. RECTUM AND ANUS. ► Bleeding piles for two days, [10] . ► Feeling of weight in lower part of rectum, and a sensation like aching, after dinner (ninth day), [17b] . ► Violent itching in anus, worse at night, in bed, [10] . STOOL. ► Diarrha. ► Nightly diarrha for two weeks, without colic, [2] . ► Two stools daily, [1] . ► Two easy soft stools every day, preceded by some griping, which is relieved after the stool, [1] . ► Two passages from bowels, in afternoon, the last one with straining, [24] . ► Constipation. ► Constipation, only one passage in a week, [25] . [180.] ► Violent constipation, lasting all the time while taking, and for a long time after, [10] . ► Disposed to costiveness throughout the whole proving, [17b] . ► Stools hard and too large (second day), [7] . URINARY ORGANS. ► Urethra. ► Pain like a soreness in the urethra, while urinating, although it is not painful to pressure, [1] . ► Sensation as if there were a raw spot in centre of urethra, which woke him up two nights in succession, [10] . ► Urgent desire to urinate (after ten minutes), [9] . ► Micturition. ► Increase of urinary discharges, [10] . ► Great increase in flow of urine and saliva, lasting one hour, with shooting pain in left side of head, from occiput to forehead, [22] . ► More profuse discharge of clear urine, [10] . ► Urine. ► Urine tinged yellow (third day), [8] . [190.] ► Urine turbid, [15] . SEXUAL ORGANS. ► Male. ► Redness and swelling of the prepuce; it looks sore, with itching pain, [1] . ► Small red spots on the glans penis, [1] . ► Two small red spots appeared on each side of the glans, secreting a large quantity of lardaceous matter. It had the appearance, according to his opinion, of herpes preputialis, [10] . ► Shining red points on the glans, as if pimples would form, [1] . ► Penis swollen, [1] . ► Jerking in the penis, [1] . ► Violent erections in the evening, [10] . ► Violent erections in the evening, in bed, [1] . ► Tearing stitches in the glans, [1] . [200.] ► Itching pain in the fossa behind the glans penis; pus having a nauseous sweetish odor oozes out, [1] . ► Violent itching of the corona glandis, with a profuse secretion of pus; the itching was so violent as to cause him to rub it, which only ceased it for a short time, to return with tenfold violence, [10] . ► Burning, sticking itching on the corona glandis, in the evening, relieved by rubbing, soon after, returning more violent than ever, [1] . ► Sexual excitement on the least provocation (second day), [20] . ► Sexual excitement, as if about to have an emission, but is able to combat the feeling, at 2.30 P.M. (second day), [20] . ► Increased sexual desire, with erections, which continued at night, terminating by an emission of semen (second day), [16b] . ► After finishing the medicine, all desire for an embrace is lost, which was not the case before the took the medicine, [10] . ► Female. ► *Leucorrha, the discharge of which causes a pressure in the vagina , [1] . RESPIRATORY ORGANS. ► Voice. ► Hoarseness of the voice, in the morning, going off in two or three hours, [13] . ► Every evening, hoarseness with crouplike cough, [10] . ► Cough. [210.] ► Cough, [3] . ► (On lying down she is compelled to cough incessantly, relieved by sitting up; single, very dry shocks of cough), [1] . CHEST. ► Front. ► Pain under lower point of sternum, extending to left side under short ribs, [10] . ► Pain running near ensiform cartilage from the seventh rib on right side, diagonally through to the chest, [21] . ► A severe pain extending from the cartilage of the seventh rib at its junction with the sternum, to the right hypochondriac region under the inferior border of the tenth rib, from 4 to 5 P.M. (second day), [16] . ► Sticking in chest, just beneath sternum, [15] . ► Sides. ► Pain in upper part of left and right lung, [10] . ► Pain on seventh rib of each side, in a spot as large as a quarter dollar, more on left side, [10] . ► Occasional pains in left side of chest, between cartilages of fifth and sixth ribs (second day). Returned in evening, in region of heart, of a sharp cutting character, producing difficulty in getting breath, while they continued (third day). Returned in forenoon, followed by wandering pains throughout whole chest (fourth day), [16] . ► Soreness under right breast, near last true rib, particularly on drawing breath, [25] . HEART AND PULSE. ► Præcordium. [220.] ► *An inward soreness over the heart, extending along the left arm on taking a long breath, [10] . ► Heart's Action. ► Nervous trembling of the heart, with anxiety, to which she was formerly subject, again returns, in evening, [24] . ► Pulse. ► Pulse at first rapid, intermitting, strong, afterwards tremulously weak, [3] . ► Pulse, which was at 12 M. from 44 to 52, rose at 4 P.M. to 80, [15] . ► Pulse 60, at noon; 80 in evening (second day), [19] . ► Pulse 60 (second day), [7] . ► Seems to lower the pulse in forenoon and make it irregular, [15] . ► Throbbing-like pulse and sticking here and there near the sternum and beneath the short ribs, mostly when walking, least when sitting and lying, [1] . NECK AND BACK. ► Neck. ► Pain in back part of neck, when head is thrown back, extending to occiput, [10] . ► Pain on right side of neck, below the sterno-cleido-mastoid muscle, on turning head, [10] . [230.] ► The muscles of the back part of neck seem as if contracted, [10] . ► Pain as if dislocated in the cervical vertebræ, [2] . ► Soreness from right ear into the middle of the posterior cervical region, as if the glands were affected (second day). Soreness increased, very severe in evening (third day), [150] . ► Back. ► Tearing pain and a sensation as if everything would separate in the side of the back, especially at night, on the slightest motion in bed, and also in the arm while writing, both relieved by the warmth of the stove, [1] . ► Dorsal. ► General pain all over the back, down to loins, worse after every dose of medicine, aggravated on drawing a long breath, [10] . ► Dull pain in lower dorsal portion of spine, continuing only for a short time (after ten minutes), [9] . ► Sticking pain in region of left side of fifth and sixth dorsal vertebræ, in evening (fifth day). Same pain occasionally on the right side of same vertebræ (sixth day), [17b] . ► Lumbar. ► Aching in small of back, as if bruised, [24] . ► Aching pain in small of back and legs (sixth day), [11] . ► Aching across small of back and in limbs, in morning (third day), [11] . [240.] ► Severe aching and drawing pains in back, from region of kidneys to sacrum, and in thighs and legs, all last night and to-day. Drawing up of legs affords relief. (The pains in legs were exactly like those he suffered years ago from Calomel ), (seventh day), [11] . ► Awaked by a dull sticking pain in region of left kidney, which lasted but a short time, about 4 A.M. Afterwards, tossing about and sleeplessness for an hour (fifth day), [17b] . ► Sharp pain, at night, in region of kidneys, as if a nail had been driven in on each side of the vertebræ, [10] . EXTREMITIES IN GENERAL. ► Paralytic sensation in all the limbs; he is heavy and sleepy, [1] . ► Numbness and heavy aching in arms and knees, and lower legs, at 8 P.M. (second day), [8] . ► Pain in all the joints, with lameness, during the day (second day), [19] . ► Dull aching in bones of forearms and legs (second day), [7] . ► Dull aching pain in bones of forearms and legs (after six hours and three-quarters), [8] . SUPERIOR EXTREMITIES. ► dema of right arm, [26] . ► Pain along left arm, particularly in little finger, third finger, and thumb, [10] . [250.] ► Wakened several times from sleep at night by a severe pain in right arm. It continued next morning and during the day; at times very severe, commencing about the centre of the os humeri, and extending to the elbow and along the radius to its inferior extremity; the pain was of a heavy, aching character, deepseated, and caused lameness and difficulty in moving the arm (fourth day), [16] . ► Severe stitches, at times, in the arm, [1] . ► Shoulder. ► Lame sensation in right shoulder-joint, in evening (second day), [17] . ► Elbow. ► The least twitch causes the elbow-joint and shoulder to crack, [10] . ► Numb feeling in elbows, as if the ulnar nerve was compressed, also numbness in knee-joints, [15] . ► A constant pain in left arm-joint when turning and straightening the arm and when writing, [10] . ► On supinating the forearm, the pain is worse at the elbow; it feels as if the "crazy-bone" were struck, [10] . ► Forearm. ► Numbness of left arm, from elbow down to end of little finger, [8] . ► Numbness in left arm, from elbow to end to little finger, passing off on using the arm, and returning again while at rest (second day), [7] . ► Fingers. ► Pain in right little finger, [10] . [260.] ► Occasional shooting and prickling pain in the two middle fingers of left hand, better by firm pressure upon thumb (after two hours), [12] . ► Sharp darting pains like electric flashes, passing from the first phalanx of ring finger of right hand to middle of forearm, and from lower extremity of radius of left arm up to elbow (after one hour), [16] . INFERIOR EXTREMITIES. ► Lameness and frequent stitches on walking, particularly inner side of knee-joint (second day), [18] . ► Tired feeling in all the joints of lower extremities, better from rising and walking, [20] . ► Drawing in all the muscles of the lower extremities, on the under surface, [10] . ► Hip. ► Pain and tired feeling in right hip, and afterwards in left, [20] . ► Thigh. ► Aching pains in thighs, during day and night (second day), [11] . ► Drawing-aching pains in thighs, from the hip-joints nearly down to the condyles, aggravated by moving, and accompanied with great lameness on getting up and attempting to walk, getting better after walking a short distance, [11] . ► Shooting-aching pain on posterior side of right thigh, from hip-joint to middle of os femoris, on straining at stool (after two hours), [11] . ► Knee. ► Pain in knee-joint, worse at noon, while walking, [10] . [270.] ► Frequent pain in lower side of left knee, near inner side of tibia (second day), [18] . ► Sticking pain in back part of left knee-joint for a short time in forenoon (second day), [17b] . ► A slight sticking pain in right knee-joint, with a creeping sensation above and below it, seemingly about the bone, lasting about an hour, in afternoon (second day), [17b] . ► Leg. ► Painful jerking in the lower leg, in the evening, after going to sleep, awakens him, [1] . ► Pain in tendo Achillis and os calcis after walking, [15] . ► Ankle. ► Sore feeling of the ankle, attended with heat and itching over the whole leg, [10] . ► Foot. ► Pressive sensation in the foot, as if it would go to sleep, [1] . ► Toes. ► (Rheumatic pain in the great toe), [1] . GENERALITIES. ► Objective. ► Nervous system excited, [20] . ► Lassitude, weariness, [10] . [280.] ► Uncommon tiredness and weakness (sixth day), [11] . ► Great weakness of all the limbs, in morning (second day), [7] . ► Continual restlessness and dreams that a lump is in his throat and right ear, [11] . ► Great restlessness and nervousness (second day), [19] . ► Nervousness and irritability for a short time, about noon (second day), [17b] . ► Subjective. ► Heaviness and sleepiness during day (fifth day), [17b] . ► A dull, heavy, and at times a sleepy feeling during day (second day), [11] . ► Sense of languor and depression, as after excessive exhilaration or intoxication; this continued, with intermission, for three days (second day), [18] . ► Felt wearied in body and confused in mind on going to bed (after ten minutes), [9] . ► Feels very tired in morning, after restless sleep with many dreams (third day), [11] . [290.] ► Feeling of depression and weakness of whole system, as after a severe illness (second day), [7] . ► Feeling as if an attack of typhus fever were coming on, [10] . ► Sense of general prostration in morning (second day), [7] . ► General nervous, uneasy sensation (second day), [20] . ► A peculiar nervous thrill pervading the whole frame, even to the fingers and toes, affecting especially the joints (second day), [18] . ► Sensation of having taken cold, [20] . ► A very uncomfortable sensation in the body after eating, as if it were distended and puffed up; sensation across the chest and stomach, as if oppressed, [1] . SKIN. ► Objective. ► Redness of skin, like a chronic eruption, [25] . ► Eruptions, Dry. ► Eruption on posterior cervical region, [20] . ► Eruption on inner and lower part of thigh, with itching (second day), [19] . [300.] ► (Warts here and there on the prepuce, which bleed when touched), [1] . ► Eruptions, Moist. ► A small pimple (like a transparent vesicle), sore to touch, on inner edge of eyelid, near the spot where the pain was, the latter having disappeared (second day), [17] . ► Right middle finger and palm of hand, scurvy tetter exedens, [10] . ► Eruptions, Pustular. ► (The margin of ulcers becomes painful and tense), [2] . ► Sore in inside of under lip towards the left, [11] . ► Subjective. ► From the first, felt as if pimples would come out over his body, with general uneasy sensation and itching; (has had this feeling for some time, but now in an aggravated form), [20] . ► Itching at night, especially on inside of thighs, [20] . ► Itching in various parts of the body while walking in open air, [17b] . ► Itching over the body during the day (second day), [17b] . ► Spot on right side, on one of the ribs (seventh and eighth), as large as a wafer, very sore to touch, with occasionally a sore pain in and around it (fourth day); some pains on left side, but without the sore spot (fifth day), [17b] . [310.] ► Itching of eyelids and of various parts of body (sixth day), [17b] . ► Itching of nose, with bleeding, after blowing it; the blood is very dark; the itching is caused by pimples at right nostril, [10] . ► Itching on left side of face, [10] . ► Itching in palm of right hand, [10] . ► Violent itching on the inside of the thighs, knees, and legs, worse at the knees, especially at night (sixth day), [11] . ► Violent itching and pricking on inner side of knee-joint ever since he began to take the medicine, worse in the night and the morning before getting up, [11] . ► Sticking-itching in the forepart of the throat, forepart of the chest, with swollen cervical glands; red points appear, forming round spots, with hard granular pimples; this eruption burns and itches, especially on scratching; at last the spots became painful, [1] . SLEEP AND DREAMS. ► Sleepiness. ► Drowsiness, [25] . ► Great drowsiness and lassitude in warm room (after two hours), [12] . ► Unusual drowsiness in morning, [24] . [320.] ► Unusual drowsiness and heaviness over eyes (after three hours), [24] . ► Felt a drowsy sensation, as though he could sleep readily; went to bed at 12 o'clock (after two hours), [20] . ► Desire to sleep during day, [17] . ► Disposition to sleep during the day, [10] . ► Disposition to fall asleep while listening to the lecture, several times, notwithstanding great effort to keep awake, at 11 A.M. (third day), [8] . ► Great inclination to sleep during day (third day), [17b] . ► Sleeplessness. ► No desire for sleep, but sat up and read until 1.30 A.M.; did not sleep for half an hour after going to bed, [20] . ► Restlessness at night, [17] . ► Restlessness and sleeplessness during night from a constant flow of ideas, changing from one subject to another, [16] . ► Great restlessness at night, continual dreaming and waking, [11] . [330.] ► Restless and tossing about during the whole night, with anxious dreams, which he is wholly unable to recall after awaking (second day), [7] . ► Restless, uneasy sleep; increased restlessness on following night, with constant dreaming; seemed to dream before getting to sleep, [19] . ► Sleep restless, with vivid dreams, but he cannot remember them in morning, [15] . ► Still had drowsy sensation on going to bed, and very strong desire to sleep, but could not sleep on account of a disagreeable nervous sensation, which cause him to toss about in bed for an hour and a half, [20] . ► After retiring, did not sleep for over an hour, but tossed about, very nervous and mentally vexed, [20] . ► Wakes up suddenly, as from a dream, [25] . ► Waking suddenly after midnight, as from a dream, he has no breath, like a nightmare, [1] . ► Awoke and started up several times without purpose, [9] . ► Loss of sleep during forepart of night (second day), [7] . ► Loss of sleep at night, without pains and without exhaustion; in the morning he feels strengthened, and as if he had no need of sleep, [1] . [340.] ► Nightly sleeplessness; hears the clock strike every hours, [25] . ► Sensation as if he had not had a refreshing sleep, at 8 A.M., on waking (second day), [20] . ► Dreams. ► Dreamed continually, [20] . ► He would be scarcely lost in a drowse before he would be dreaming, [11] . ► Dreams, with much talking in sleep, which is very restless, [10] . ► Had several dreams, and woke several times during night, [11] . ► Many dreams, and waked up often, [11] . ► Vivid dreams of studies and business, etc., [11] . ► Vivid dreams of the lectures, particularly the anatomical, during the night; could not believe that he was not actually there (third day), [11] . ► Slept not so well as the night before, and his dreams are vivid and rather pleasing, but he cannot bring them to his recollection; (he dreams more or less every night, but thinks the above dreams were rather unusually vivid), [20] . [350.] ► Unusually vivid dreams of a sensual nature, [24] . ► Slept very well, but had very vivid dreams, which he could not remember, [20] . ► Although accustomed to dream much, yet he had more troublesome dreams than usual, [9] . ► In one of his dreams, saw a spider as large as an ox, [9] . FEVER. ► Chilliness. ► Chilliness in warm room, [8] . ► Feeling of coldness and sensation of inertia, [25] . ► Sensation as if a cold breeze was blowing upon the eyes, very marked, in afternoon, when sitting in house (second day), [18] . ► A space about the size of a quarter-dollar, just above and between the supraorbital regions (root of nose?), felt as though pressed upon by a cold metallic body, while within the cranium underneath there seemed to be more warmth than usual (after ten minutes), [9] . ► Coldness in the joints; shivering and drawing in the arms and legs, [1] . ► Hands cold, [15] . ► Heat. [360.] ► Fever, [26] . ► Occasionally, fever and fulness in forehead, [20] . ► From the front to the back of the head, mostly over right eye and temple, heat in the head (second day), [7] . ► Front of head very hot (after half an hour), [8] . ► Heat rises from the stomach into the throat and head, at night, while lying in bed, disappears on sitting up, [1] . ► Flashes of heat, confined to abdomen, with great flatulence, [13] . ► Abdomen, below transverse colon, felt hot (after three hours), [6] . ► Sensation of warmth under sternum (second day), [18] . ► Felt a warm glow through legs, soon succeeded by a dull pain in left arm, just above elbow, and occasional darting pains in lower extremities (after ten minutes), [9] . ► Sweat. ► Perspiration about 12 M., [10] . [370.] ► Skin moist and cool (second day), [7] . ► Sweat between the thighs while walking; it has an offensive odor and is corrosive, [1] . ► Profuse sweating between the thighs, [10] . CONDITIONS. ► Aggravation. ► ( Morning ), On rising, etc. 7 o'clock, giddiness, etc.; after waking, especially when lying in left side and pressing forehead into pillow, pain in forehead; on waking, especially when lying on left side and back, aching pain in forehead; on waking, pain in organ of Conscientiousness ; after rising from bed, fulness, etc.; in occiput, etc.; furred tongue; after rising, drawing in mouth; on waking, at 8 o'clock, throat dry; appetite impaired; head full; at 11 o'clock, feeling in umbilical region; pain in knee-joint. ► ( Noon ), While walking, pain in knee-joint; nervousness, etc.; perspiration. ► ( Afternoon ), From 4 to 5 o'clock, pain from ribs to hypochondriac region; pain in knee-joint; sensation on eyes. ► ( Evening ), All pains; pain in forehead; pain in right frontal region; shooting in temple; soreness of eyes; erections; hoarseness; soreness from ear to neck; pain in side of dorsal vertebræ; at 8 o'clock, numbness, etc., in limbs; sensation in shoulder-joint. ► ( Night ), Dryness, etc., in mouth; itching in anus; on motion in bed, pain in back; itching inside of thighs; Hoarseness in the evening. Dyspnœa, with heat. Cough from tickling in the throat. Dry cough, in single shocks, when lying down; > by sitting up. Pain in the l. shoulder, between the clavicle and scapula, interiorly. Pain in the middle of the upper part of r. arm, as though it would break. Periodical shooting pains in the arms. Tearing in the arms when writing, > by the heat of the fire. Sensation of lameness in r. arm. Numbness of l. arm, from elbow to end of little finger, it feels as if the "crazy-bone" was struck. The joints of the fingers and knuckles are red (and hot). Painful jerking in the leg, in the evening, after sleeping. Shooting, drawing, and aching pains in the thighs, from the hip-joints nearly down to the condyles; at night. Violent itching on the inside of thighs, knees, and legs; worse in the knees, esp. at night. Profuse perspiration between the thighs (when walking). Rheumatic pain in r. knee-joint; when walking (ascending), > at rest. Pain in the tendo Achillis and os calcis after walking. Coldness in the joints. Coldness of the feet, day and night. Sensation of lameness in all the limbs. Pulling and shuddering in the arms and the legs. Paralytic pains in the limbs, with indolence and drowsiness. Weariness, languor, tired and prostrated; worse before eating, better when riding in the open air. General nervous, uneasy sensation.

General nervous, uneasy sensation. Great lassitude, prostration, and feeling of lameness in limbs. Weariness, languor, tiredness and prostration ; < before eating, > when riding in open air. Sensation of lameness in all the limbs. Frequent emissions of watery urine. Intermitting : pain of kerato-iritis and uncomplicated iritis. Coming and going gradually : sensation as if right molars and bicuspids were soft, heavy and too large. Lasting about an hour : uneasy creeping and pressive sensation about ossa nasi. Long continued : false labor pains. During whole night : internal and external heat of body. Nightly fever with dry mouth. Periodical : shooting pains in arms. Day and night : coldness of feet. Right : aching in superciliary ridge of eye ; inflammation of eye ; itching, pressing and pricking at inner angle and lower lid ; shooting at canthus of eye, with burning and itching ; scurfy eruption in external ear ; itching in ear ; molars and bicuspids feel soft, heavy and too large ; second upper decayed molar feels as if it would fly to pieces on biting teeth together ; small ulcer on side of tongue ; pain in middle of upper part of arm, as if it would break ; sensation of lameness in arm ; œdema of arm ; rheumatic pain in knee joint ; itching of palm of hand ; red eruption, sometimes with pustules filled with yellow matter, under knee ; nostrils somewhat tumefied. Left : dull pain in temple and side of head ; shooting pain in side of head ; outer half of eye injected and puffy ; severe pains seeming to run around eye ; pain in shoulder, between clavicle and scapula, interiorly ; numbness of arm, from elbow to end of little finger ; itching of side of face. From right to left and from left to right : shooting across abdomen during pregnancy. General nervous, uneasy sensation. As if touched by a cold metallic body on a small space over root of nose ; as of a vise or band around head ; as of congestion in forehead ; as of putting on a heavy pair of spectacles ; as if right molars and bicuspids were soft, heavy and too large ; as if second right upper decayed molar would fly to pieces on biting teeth together ; as if upper abdomen was distended ; as of a large worm in anus ; as if a sore was in urethra when urinating ; as if chest was contracted ; as if muscles of back part of neck were contracted ; as if bruised in small of back ; as if upper part of right arm would break ; as if pimples were coming out over body ; as if crazy-bone was struck. Pain : in forehead and top of head ; from back of head to forehead ; severe, running around left eye ; from inner canthus around eye ; in urethra on urinating ; running over ensiform cartilage from seventh rib on right side diagonally through chest to back ; in back of neck shooting to occiput ; all over back down to loins ; in left shoulder, between clavicle and scapula, interiorly ; in upper part of right arm ; in tendo-achillis and os calcis. Cutting : in forehead. Sudden stitches : on each side of spine, in back and lumbar region. Stitching : above eye, from internal and external canthus, or runs around eye ; may extend into eye, or up into head. Sticking : about punctum lachrymale of upper eyelid. Stinging : in ears, cheeks, temples and sides of head, extending to occiput and nape of neck ; above eye, from internal to external canthus, or runs around eye ; may extend into eye or up into head. Pricking : at inner angle and lower lid of right eye. Shooting : in left side of head ; from occiput forward ; in forehead ; through eye into head ; at inner canthus of right eye ; across abdomen during pregnancy ; in arms ; in thighs, from hip joints nearly down to condyles. Tearing : in forehead ; in bowels ; on each side of spine, in back and lumbar region ; in legs below knees. Rending : in spine. Drawing : in thighs, from hip joints nearly down to condyles. Burning : in inner canthus of right eye ; around anus ; of skin. Soreness : over exit of supraorbital nerve ; along course of supraorbital nerve and corresponding side of head ; in roof of mouth ; of throat ; in stomach. Sharp pains : above eye, from internal to external canthus, or runs around eye ; may extend into eye or up into head. Irritation : of throat. Pressure : over root of nose, zygoma and temples ; in upper abdomen, after eating ; in vagina ; in foot. Pressing : in forehead ; at inner angle and lower lid of right eye. Pressive sensation : about ossa nasi. Oppression : of chest. Pinching : in urethra. Cramps : in bowels. Contracting pain : in throat during empty deglutition. Tensive pains : in ears, cheeks, temples and sides of head, extending to occiput and nape of neck. Labor-like pain : in vagina. Rheumatic pain : in right knee joint. Aching : in superciliary ridge of right eye, extending to back of head ; in small of back ; in thighs, from hip joints nearly down to condyles. Tightness : in temples. [The Preparations Of Mercury] nose and the character of the throat symptoms in connection with it. These symptoms may occur in the syphilitic, in the scrofulous, or in persons in whom there is tendency to catarrh. We have found Cinna- baris of use in the sore throat of scarlatina, which is often diphtheritic in its character, when there is quite an accumulation of stringy mucus in the posterior nares. That symptom being prominent, Cinnabaris will be the remedy for the emergency.
